name: Halo pairs 300 km apart (ring analogue of a toroid): field 6 min, then no field (Burke 2013)
origin: Persinger lab, Laurentian University (Burke, Gauthier, Rouleau & Persinger 2013), Arduino-driven toroid ('halo')
summary: Burke, Gauthier, Rouleau & Persinger 2013: two pairs 300 km apart, each person wearing one toroidal coil ('halo') just above the ears, the stimulus partner receiving six 30-s sound and light trains, here first with the field and then without. The paper reports sLORETA changes in the distant response partners only with the field and only for the sounds. This program is a ring analogue: the helmet has no toroid.
notes: Each halo was one winding of 225 turns on a 10-inch ring, driven with '230 amplitude-modulated points (333 Hz, 1.45 Hz cycle)' at about 1 uT, 'phase modulated in 2 ms increments (20 ms delay to 8 ms delay)' (Burke 2013 p.3 [37]). Nothing stepped from coil to coil. This helmet steps one of eight radial coils at a time, so neither the field direction nor its extent is reproduced. The paper does not say how the 230 points and the delays were combined and gives no direction. Here the seven delays (20, 18 ... 8 ms) are the time on each coil of a counter-clockwise rotation: the project's construction. With seven delays on eight coils, the 20-ms step falls one coil earlier on each pass. The 230 point values were never published; the project's rising sweep stands in, 230 points of 3 ms back to back (690 ms, 1.45 Hz). Elsewhere the lab describes this halo as seven 3-ms pulses with delays that start at 20 ms and change by 2 ms (Rouleau 2014 p.3-4 [46-47]; Scott 2015 p.15 [672]); persinger-scott-2015-transatlantic plays that reading. One helmet delivers one of the two exposures, so both partners run this program; persinger-burke-2013-halo runs the other order. The paper names only cell-phone contact between the sites, no figure for how closely the two fields were started and no place where its 1 uT was measured (p.3 [37]). This program's setting is the peak field 20 mm in front of each coil. At 1 uT the scalp gets about 24 uT. 4 people, single lab, never independently replicated. Independent sham-controlled tests of God-Helmet-type fields found no field effect (Granqvist 2005, double-blind; Gendle & McGrath 2012, where the experimenter knew the condition). Light flashes can trigger seizures in susceptible people. Do not use results for decisions about real people. Nobody with epilepsy, a seizure history or photosensitivity should take part in either role.
setting: Stimulus partner: seated, helmet on, receiving the six 30-s trains (sound at 6, 8 and 15 Hz, light at 7, 10 and 40 Hz), one per minute from the start of each phase, in a different order in the two phases. Response partner: elsewhere, second helmet running this program, EEG recorded throughout by someone who does not know which train is playing or which phase has the field.
schedule: One session per pair; run half of the pairs with persinger-burke-2013-halo.
source: Burke, Gauthier, Rouleau & Persinger 2013, Experimental demonstration of potential entanglement of brain activity over 300 km ..., J Conscious Explor Res 4(1):35-44 https://jcer.com/index.php/jcj/article/view/279 ; Rouleau & Persinger 2015, J Electromagn Anal Appl 7(2) (later description of the toroid protocol, 400 km) https://file.scirp.org/Html/1-9801584_54135.htm ; Scott et al. 2015, J Conscious Explor Res 6(9):658-684 (toroid build: 225 turns on a 25.4-cm ring) https://jcer.com/index.php/jcj/article/view/493 ; Dotta & Persinger 2012, "Doubling" of local photon emissions when two simultaneous, spatially-separated, chemiluminescent reactions share the same magnetic field configurations, J Biophys Chem 3:72-80 (859- and 230-point patterns at 1 ms; primer/effector order) https://file.scirp.org/Html/17181.html ; Juden-Kelly, Dotta, Vares & Persinger 2015, JCER 6(9):728-737 (Burst-X: 230 points) https://jcer.com/index.php/jcj/article/view/497 ; Carniello 2020, PhD thesis, Laurentian University (230-point burst-firing file) https://laurentian.scholaris.ca/items/8c92763c-cd19-4a21-b242-3b572a28ce55 ; Persinger & Lavallee 2010, Theoretical and experimental evidence of macroscopic entanglement between human brain activity and photon emissions, J Conscious Explor Res 1(7):785-807 (20+2 notation; coil 1 left frontal, coil 8 right prefrontal) https://jcer.com/index.php/jcj/article/view/99 ; Granqvist et al. 2005, Neurosci Lett 379:1-6 https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/15849873/ ; Gendle & McGrath 2012, Percept Mot Skills 114:217 https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/22582690/

phases.name: Field: 230 pts x 3 ms, delay 20->8 ms per coil, CCW
No field: six stimulus trains to the partner
